DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, EDUCATION, AND WELFARE
OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20201
1972
Mr. Sigmund C. Ziejewski Regional Transportation Engineer Department of Transportation 300 North State Street, Room 907 Chicago, Illinois 60610
Dear Mr. Zipioweki-
This is in response to your letter of April 14, 1972, wherein you requested comments on the following draft environmental impact statement.
F.A. Route 23 (U.S. Route 30) Lincoln Highway - Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road
Section: 22-23-12-R Cook County.
This Department has reviewed the health aspects of the above project as presented in the documents submitted. The proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety.
The opportunity to review this draft environmental impact statement is appreciated.
